events: waiting triggers are put on the stack
a trigger created after the boundary waits for the next end step
state_reads: active delayed triggers and their conditions
timing: the end step performs no turn-based action
the beginning boundary is dispatched exactly once
all represented waiting trigger families are collected before priority
the active player receives the first priority window
the event boundary is not repeated for a trigger created later in the step
until-end-of-turn and this-turn durations end in cleanup, not in the end step
targets: represented triggered abilities retain their compiled target schemas
choices: represented same-controller trigger groups use trigger-order decisions
hidden_information: the step boundary itself reveals no hidden information
trigger payload visibility remains governed by the compiled semantic program
apnap: represented semantic, delayed, and inherent monarch trigger families share one active-player/nonactive-player ordering batch
layers: turn-duration continuous effects remain active through the end step and expire in cleanup
replacement_effects: the end-step boundary performs no replaceable turn-based action
copy: copy status does not cause the beginning boundary to repeat
control_change: trigger controller is captured by the trigger subsystem at trigger time
zone_change: a permanent entering after the beginning boundary does not receive a retroactive trigger
source_leaves: a represented delayed trigger is independent of its source unless its compiled condition says otherwise
